title: 3D Audio Visualization (Audio Visualizer 3D)
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement a 3D spectrum visualization without a real audio file: simulate a 128-point FFT using sine/synthetic functions.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
Use the following importmap in <head>, and import via ES Modules in <script type="module">:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';
</script>

[Simulated Data]
(1) Generate 128 amplitude values (bins) per frame, using sin/cos and a low-frequency envelope to simulate beat spikes; the Web Audio API is not required.

[Modes]
(2) id="vizMode": <select> with the options bars (Cylinder bars arranged in a circle, with bar heights driven by bins), sphere (sphere vertex/instance displacement deformation), and wave (fluctuating 3D polyline/curve point sequence). Rebuild or update the geometry when switching modes.

[Visuals]
(3) Map colors by frequency: low = red, mid = green, high = blue (HSL or piecewise lerp may be used).
(4) Beat: when a simulated low-frequency transient occurs, trigger a brief full-screen or ambient-light flash (beatDetected is true for one frame).

[Controls]
(5) id="sensitivity": range approximately 0.1–3.0, scaling the amplitude mapping.

[State Exposure (Required)]
window.__3D_STATE__ = {
  vizMode: string,
  sensitivity: number,
  binCount: number,
  maxAmplitude: number,
  avgAmplitude: number,
  beatDetected: boolean,
  simTime: number
}

Output a single HTML file that can run when opened directly in a browser.
physics_constraints: 128 simulated frequency bins, no audio file
